rows.name:
You've all been working so hard, mo. I
hear about your exploits all the time,
mo!

rows.label: tlk70000002_04_msg0002
rows.name:
But Obibi isn't losing, mo! Obibi's
making another new product now, mo!
That child is helping a bit too, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000002_04_msg0003
rows.name:
The last hats were for Nopon, but
Iirans generally prefer simple clothes
in subdued colors, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000002_04_msg0004
rows.name:
But that would be too ordinary, so I'm
adding geometric patterns for a more
stylish product, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000002_04_msg0005
rows.name:
This next product is sure to be a huge
hit too, mo!
